citations.quote: Kamilah Bywaters was born and raised in Las Vegas in a working-class family grounded in education, service, and community responsibility.
Today, Kamilah serves as the Special Education Instructional Facilitator supporting educators, students, and families across the state.
At her father’s encouragement, Kamilah entered special education through an alternate route to licensure and taught in the Clark County School District.
She taught in the district for three years before resigning due to what she told The Indy was a toxic work environment.
While in a rigorous theological study, she taught in DC Public Schools and worked at Andrew Rankin Memorial Chapel as a graduate assistant to the Dean of the Chapel.
